name: Library Youth Volunteers
what_you_do: Help at one of three Chula Vista library branches. You can tutor, help with homework, shelve materials and do other tasks.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 and a half to 17. You must give at least one hour a week for six months.
duration: At least one hour a week for six months
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The library shows its youth forms all year.
how_to_apply: Pick the youth form for your branch on the library page. One form is for Civic Center. The other is for South and Otay Ranch.
notes: Sending a form does not promise you a spot. The city keeps it for six months. After that you must apply again.
